title: PostgreSQL WAL, checkpoints and durability
brief: Relate PostgreSQL WAL and checkpoint controls to a tested durability promise.
outcomes: Interpret WAL progress and commit settings
Explain an isolated crash drill without extrapolating to lost storage
entry: General crash recovery and PostgreSQL architecture.

title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
brief: Restore a PostgreSQL cluster to a verified target and account for the work outside that history.
outcomes: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain
Verify a target and reconcile later valid effects safely
entry: General backup reasoning and PostgreSQL WAL.

title: PostgreSQL physical replicas and promotion
brief: Operate a PostgreSQL physical copy and promote it with explicit authority and loss boundaries.
outcomes: Distinguish standby receipt, flush and replay
Perform fenced promotion and a safe former-primary return
entry: General replication, failover and PostgreSQL WAL.

title: PostgreSQL logical replication and change feeds
brief: Treat PostgreSQL logical replication as a selective row stream with its own identity and lifecycle.
outcomes: Configure publication and subscriber with explicit replica identity
Account for schema, sequence, lag and cutover responsibilities
entry: General replicas and PostgreSQL physical replication distinctions.

title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
brief: Choose and rehearse a PostgreSQL upgrade or migration with a recoverable write handover.
outcomes: Distinguish in-place major upgrade from logical migration
Validate compatibility, cutover and the point of no easy return
entry: Backups, logical replication, schema compatibility and authority fencing.
